name: Property Mgmt: Tenant Maintenance Request → Vendor Dispatch

nodes.name: Webhook - Maintenance Request
nodes.notes: Entry point. Receives POST from the tenant maintenance-request web form (Tally). Expects a form-response body whose data.fields[] carries tenant_name, unit_number, description, contact_phone and contact_email.

nodes.name: Normalize Request Data
nodes.notes: Normalizes the raw webhook body into clean top-level fields. Every downstream node reads tenant/request data from THIS node by name, independent of what the AI/Airtable nodes output later.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes: Language model powering the classification step. Swap the model name or credential as needed.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an expert maintenance dispatcher for a residential property management company. Read the tenant's maintenance request description and extract the requested fields. Respond only with the structured data requested — do not wrap the output in markdown code blocks.

nodes.name: Read Classification
nodes.notes: Reads the extractor output defensively. The Information Extractor nests results under `output`, but a retry or a direct-parse path can return the fields flat — this handles both instead of failing on the shape.

nodes.name: Create Maintenance Request Record
nodes.notes: Requests table columns: tenant_name, unit_number, description, contact_phone, contact_email, category (single select), urgency (single select), status (single select), created_at (date), assigned_vendor.

nodes.name: Is Emergency?
nodes.notes: TRUE (urgency = emergency): immediate Slack + SMS + email alerts. FALSE: continue to vendor matching. Reads urgency from 'Read Classification' rather than $json, because the Airtable node in between has replaced the item shape.

nodes.notes: Email fallback beside the SMS. Two independent channels for the emergency path, so a single provider outage does not lose the alert.

nodes.name: Look Up Property Service Zone
nodes.notes: A separate Properties table maps unit_number → service_zone. Looks up the zone for this request's unit_number, one record expected.

nodes.name: Find Available Vendor
nodes.notes: Filters the Vendors table by category + service_zone + status=available, limit 1 — gives the first available vendor without an extra node. Vendors table needs: category, service_zone, status, vendor_name, vendor_email.

nodes.notes: Emails the matched vendor the job details plus an accept link. The accept-link handler is out of scope for this workflow.

nodes.name: Notify Admin of Failure
nodes.notes: Shared error handler. Every external-call node's error output (Airtable, Slack, Twilio, Gmail, Information Extractor) fans into this node. Posts to a DIFFERENT channel than #maintenance-urgent so a Slack channel problem can't silently swallow both the alert and its own failure notification.

parameters.content:
## Tenant Maintenance Request → Vendor Dispatch

**1. Intake** — Webhook receives the tenant's web-form submission; fields are normalized.

**2. AI Classification** — An LLM (via the Information Extractor node) reads the free-text description and assigns a category (plumbing/electrical/hvac/appliance/general) and urgency (emergency/high/medium/low).

**3. Log the request** — A new record is created in the Airtable Requests table with status 'New'.

**4. Branch on urgency:**
- Emergency → alert #maintenance-urgent on Slack + SMS and email the on-call property manager → confirm to the tenant that help is on the way.
- High/Medium/Low → look up the property's service zone → match the first available vendor for that category+zone → email the vendor the job details → mark the record assigned → SMS the tenant with the assigned vendor's name.

**5. Error handling** — Any external-service failure (Airtable, Slack, Twilio, Gmail, the extractor) is caught on that node's error output and routed to Notify Admin of Failure, which posts to a separate ops channel.

Before activating: create the four credentials, replace every REPLACE_WITH_ placeholder with your own IDs, and point the form webhook at your intake form.
